judgments.reason: The high-sensitivity troponin T of 888 ng/L (normal 0–14 ng/L) is literally present in the vignette and clinically supports myocardial injury/NSTEMI as part of the ACS diagnosis.
The ECG showing 'No apparent abnormalities on current admission' is literally present in the vignette and clinically supports NSTEMI (elevated troponin without ST-elevation) rather than STEMI.
